regions.today: Today will be another dull day. After a dry start for most, patches of rain and drizzle will spread from the west, becoming more persistent through the afternoon. The rain will occasionally turn heavy this evening. Highest temperatures of 14 to 17 degrees in moderate south to southwest winds, fresh near southeast coasts.
regions.tonight: Rain this evening will clear eastwards by early tonight. Long clear spells will develop. Some mist patches will develop too. Lowest temperatures of 5 to 9 degrees in light southwest to west winds.
regions.tomorrow: Monday: A bright start to the week on Monday with sunshine. Showers will spread from the west, occasionally falling heavy. Highest temperatures of 13 to 16 degrees in moderate west to southwest winds.
regions.solar_uv: Low to moderate, high in any sunshine.
